title: sensor.<ns>_client_<slug>_<uid8>_notifications
description: Active notifications of one client (full content, same item shape as WS 'notifications'); state = count. The id is delivered as client_config.notification_sensor. Written by the hub via POST /core/api/states/<entity_id>; while the hub does not answer, the integration writes it in the same shape and hands its changes over later (POST /api/integration/notifications/handover); not persistent in HA (gone after a Core restart until the next resync). Readable with every HA token.

pending_handover.description: Only while not empty: ids of items the integration wrote while the hub was unreachable and has not handed over yet. The hub's own sensor update keeps these items (if younger than 72 h and not in its database) until the handover, so apps never lose them in between. Apps ignore the attribute.
